digest.component_or_area: src/rebar codebase-wide comment audit and consolidation
propositions: ~2,033 lines of recoverable comment content across 439 files in src/rebar can be relocated to destination taxonomy (history to tickets, architecture to ADRs, contracts to schema) and reduced to citations inline

Self-referential prose explaining the 800-line module cap occupies 28 sites in reconciler and blocks genuine headroom recovery in hotspot files (runner.py, dispatch_one.py, inbound_differ.py, fetcher.py)
Three files (event_append.py, _processors.py, signing.py) cannot safely relocate their comments because they encode replay-compatibility and security invariants that are load-bearing call-graph seams

Six shards of triage work each must produce a do_not_move list documenting blocks that appear relocatable but are load-bearing (measured external-API facts, anti-refactor warnings, pragmas), which must be recorded in .joe-janitor/tools.md before edits land

Verified-stale comments (six instances: incorrect deterministic floor bounds, stale Anthropic constraints, obsolete module paths, mismatched key maps) must be corrected in place where they document live invariants, not deleted
~13 new ADRs are required to consolidate 4-8 redundant restatements of the same argument across codebase, including the idempotent-transform-fit-then-normalize pattern repeated at 8 sites
